customer: Traded in my compact sedan for something bigger, but my regular loan payment went out after you paid it off. How do I get that back?
agent: Since your lender received both our payoff and your regular payment, that extra amount belongs to you. Your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward overpayments, so if the refund doesn't arrive, please contact your lender.
